title: Quaint Springy Ukrainian Pork Dumplings
description: Fatty and springy Ukrainian dish featuring pork and romantic flavors, made with a Cajun twist and cooked in a bain-marie, perfect for a special occasion, this nut-free-friendly recipe is sure to delight
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, chopped onion, minced garlic, Cajun seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Gradually add the flour to the pork mixture, and mix until a dough forms.
Beat in the eggs until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for about 5 minutes, until it becomes shiny and springy.
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and reduce the heat to a simmer.
Gently add the dumplings to the pot, and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon, and serve hot.
To cook in a bain-marie, place the dumplings in a heatproof bowl, and set the bowl over a pot of simmering water, covering the bowl with a lid.
Steam the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they are cooked through and fluffy.
